faq.title: Get Your Questions Answered
faq.description: Everything you need to know to start your journey to the United States with legal security.

faqs.question: What types of visas do you help obtain?
faqs.answer: We assist with a wide variety of visas, including asylum applications, work visas (H-1B, L-1, O-1), investor visa (EB-5), family reunification (Green Card), and immigration regularization. Each case is analyzed individually to identify the best legal strategy.

faqs.question: What is the average time to regularize my situation?
faqs.answer: The timeframe varies significantly depending on the process type. Asylum applications can be completed in months, while Green Cards through family or employment ties typically take 1 to 3 years. During our initial consultation, we present a realistic estimate for your specific case.

faqs.question: Are my data treated confidentially?
faqs.answer: Yes, 100%. All information shared with us is protected by rigorous privacy protocols. Our professionals follow an ethical code of conduct and never disclose client data to third parties. Your security and peace of mind are our priority.

faqs.question: Can I start the process while in Brazil?
faqs.answer: Yes. We serve clients from any location completely remotely. We conduct video consultations, process documents digitally, and guide you at every stage before even arriving in the United States. You can start the process today.

faqs.question: What documents are needed to start?
faqs.answer: Basic documents typically include a valid passport, birth certificate, proof of residence, and depending on the process type, professional documentation or family tie proof. At our first consultation, we provide a detailed and personalized list for your case.

faqs.question: How does the follow-up process work?
faqs.answer: You'll have a dedicated consultant available via WhatsApp, email, and video calls. We send proactive updates with every status change, prepare you for authority interviews, and review all documentation before submission. You'll never be alone on this journey.

notary.description: Official document authentication for immigration processes, international contracts, and legal use in the United States.
notary.service1_text: Identity verification of the signer and authentication of signatures on legal documents.
notary.service2_text: Certification that document copies are true to the originals, accepted by government agencies and consulates.
notary.service3_text: Formalization of powers of attorney, affidavits, and sworn statements valid in the USA.
notary.service4_text: Guidance and support for apostilling Brazilian documents for international use.
